risk_description: Assisted access pathway may create demand that exceeds staffing and funding
Institution may consult the council without granting decision influence
Simplified language may conflict with policy interpretations or legal requirements
Outreach may miss people outside known community networks
Institution may identify burden but fail to fund repair pathways
Dashboard may privilege measurable outputs over dignity and public value
Participatory budgeting may raise expectations beyond available resources
AI synthesis may flatten minority signals or overstate public consensus
Resilience hub may depend on short-term funding and temporary partnerships
